title: Route telemetry fidelity controller and per-hop decision API
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add a telemetry fidelity controller and a lightweight per-hop decision API to improve the observability of smart routing policies (region selection, tier routing, fallback model variants) while controlling ingestion cost and preserving PII/sensitive context. The feature exposes a sampled, verifiable decision transcript per request, per-hop micro-metrics (latency, token cost delta, model variant used, fallback reason), and a dynamic sampling controller that adapts fidelity based on traffic patterns, active incidents, and SLO targets.
acceptance_criteria: A REST API endpoint /routing/v1/decision/{request_id} returns a signed, size-limited transcript for sampled requests within retention window
Per-hop metrics (hop_latency_ms, hop_token_count, hop_model_variant, hop_fallback_reason) emitted to observability pipeline for sampled and high-fidelity buckets
A controller exists to switch between three fidelity levels (low, adaptive, high) based on SLO breach signals and a cost budget configuration
End-to-end latency regression < 1% p95 on 99th percentile read path during experiments
Data governance: sensitive payloads are redacted before persistence; keys for signing use customer KMS where required
implementation_notes: Instrumentation: extend routing-core to attach a compact DecisionFrame for each hop (fingerprint, model_hash, variant_tag, cost_estimate, reason_code)
Sampling: implement a token-bucket based sampler with adaptive multiplier from fidelity-controller service; provide overrides per-customer and per-route
Storage: use compressed append-only store (existing trace blob store) with TTL and per-customer encryption; retain only sampled transcripts
API: lightweight read API that returns base64 gzipped transcript and a verification signature; include headers to indicate sampling decision and variant lineage
Observability: map per-hop fields to existing metric names with new labels: routing_policy, region, tier, decision_fidelity
Cost: estimate ~25% increase in trace-store writes for high-fidelity traffic; provide cost caps and auto-backoff via controller
